label: Wholesale Distributors
description: Bulk orders, dispatches and institutional account follow-up.

workflows.label: Bulk orders
workflows.description: Track quantities, customer references and fulfilment. Stock is adjusted separately through sales or batches.

workflows.label: Dispatches
workflows.description: Coordinate bulk dispatches and proof-of-delivery references.

workflows.label: Account follow-ups
workflows.description: Plan trade-account collection and account-service tasks. Payment entries are manual records.

label: Concert & Event Management Companies
description: Plan events, bookings and production tasks without mixing them with retail tools.

workflows.label: Events
workflows.description: Coordinate the venue and event schedule; ticketing and public-safety approvals are handled separately.

workflows.label: Production tasks
workflows.description: Track suppliers, staging and production deliverables.

workflows.label: Sponsorships
workflows.description: Record sponsor commitments and manually received payments.

label: Event Equipment Rental Services
description: Reserve individual assets, track returns and coordinate maintenance.

workflows.label: Equipment reservations
workflows.description: Reserve an individual asset or kit. Use a unique asset ID for each independently rentable resource.

workflows.label: Returns & inspections
workflows.description: Record condition and return checks against a reservation.

workflows.label: Maintenance
workflows.description: Block the asset while maintenance takes place.

label: Agribusiness & Produce Dealers
description: Organize produce lots, aggregation and delivery records.

workflows.label: Produce lots
workflows.description: Record produce origin, weight and grade. Shared batches track sellable stock separately.

workflows.label: Aggregation orders
workflows.description: Track sourcing agreements and collection targets.

workflows.label: Produce deliveries
workflows.description: Track delivery milestones and export documentation references; no customs filing is performed.

label: Retail Supermarkets & Minimarts
description: Keep everyday checkout, stock and customer service close at hand.

workflows.label: Special orders
workflows.description: Track customer requests and collections outside everyday checkout.

workflows.label: Replenishment tasks
workflows.description: Coordinate shelf replenishment. Goods receipt and counts remain in inventory tools.

workflows.label: Customer service
workflows.description: Track customer follow-up independently of refund records.

label: Clearing & Forwarding Agencies
description: Follow shipments, clearance tasks and delivery milestones.

workflows.label: Shipments
workflows.description: Track shipment references and milestones. Official customs submissions and carrier feeds are separate integrations.

workflows.label: Clearance checklist
workflows.description: Track document and clearance follow-ups without storing government credentials.

workflows.label: Delivery milestones
workflows.description: Record the last-mile handover and client-service steps.

label: Digital & Social Media Marketing Agencies
description: Manage campaign briefs, content deadlines and client retainers.

workflows.label: Campaigns
workflows.description: Plan campaign goals, channels and delivery dates. Social-platform publishing is separate.

workflows.label: Content deliverables
workflows.description: Track content briefs, assigned creators and client approval.

workflows.label: Client retainers
workflows.description: Track service periods and manually received retainer payments.

label: Real Estate Development & Agencies
description: Organize properties, viewings and lease-service follow-up.

workflows.label: Property pipeline
workflows.description: Track listing and development administration; this is not a land-title register.

workflows.label: Viewings
workflows.description: Reserve an agent appointment for a property viewing.

workflows.label: Lease follow-ups
workflows.description: Track lease periods, rent-service tasks and manual receipts. Legal contracts remain separate documents.

label: Tour Operators & Travel Agencies
description: Plan itineraries, customer reservations and supplier confirmations.

workflows.label: Travel bookings
workflows.description: Track customer reservations and booking references; no live airline or hotel booking is performed.

workflows.label: Itinerary tasks
workflows.description: Coordinate destinations, guides and itinerary deliverables.

workflows.label: Supplier confirmations
workflows.description: Track hotel, transport and activity confirmations.

label: Hardware & Construction Material Suppliers
description: Coordinate material quotations, site deliveries and fabrication orders.

workflows.label: Material orders
workflows.description: Track material requirements and quoted totals; record stock movements through inventory.

workflows.label: Site deliveries
workflows.description: Coordinate site delivery and unloading requirements.

workflows.label: Fabrication jobs
workflows.description: Record custom dimensions, assigned workshop and production status.

label: Mobile Money Transfer & Banking Agents
description: Record service commissions and daily cash/float reconciliation.

workflows.label: Agent service log
workflows.description: Record an external provider transaction reference and earned commission. No transfer, deposit or withdrawal is executed here; never enter customer PINs.

workflows.label: Cash & float checks
workflows.description: Record expected and counted cash/float for reconciliation; this does not connect to a banking ledger.

workflows.label: Service follow-ups
workflows.description: Track provider support references and unresolved service issues.

label: Restaurants, Lounges & Nightclubs
description: Organize tables, service orders and private functions.

workflows.label: Table reservations
workflows.description: Reserve an individual table or private space.

workflows.label: Service orders
workflows.description: Track kitchen/bar service tasks. Record the final stock sale and payment through checkout where required.

workflows.label: Private functions
workflows.description: Coordinate private-space bookings and function requirements.

label: Private Healthcare Facilities & Pharmacies
description: Coordinate administrative appointments, pharmacy sourcing and service follow-ups.

workflows.label: Administrative appointments
workflows.description: Track a contact reference, clinician slot and administration fee only. Do not enter diagnoses, medical histories, prescriptions or test results.

workflows.label: Pharmacy sourcing
workflows.description: Plan medicine-stock sourcing; batches/expiry remain in stock tools. This does not provide clinical or dispensing authorization.

workflows.label: Administrative follow-ups
workflows.description: Track administrative service and billing tasks without clinical records.

label: Software Development & IT Consultancies
description: Track projects, milestones and support agreements.

workflows.label: Projects
workflows.description: Track scope, delivery dates and project financial records.

workflows.label: Project milestones
workflows.description: Record deliverables, owners and acceptance follow-up.

workflows.label: Support requests
workflows.description: Track service requests and customer updates. Never store passwords, API secrets or recovery codes.

label: Public Transport Companies (Matatu Saccos)
description: Plan vehicle trips, service tasks and trip-account reconciliations.

workflows.label: Vehicle trips
workflows.description: Reserve a vehicle for a route and departure window. GPS tracking, ticketing and SACCO compliance filings are separate.

workflows.label: Vehicle maintenance
workflows.description: Block a vehicle while scheduled service is performed.

workflows.label: Trip reconciliations
workflows.description: Record trip expenses and collection references. No fare payment is collected automatically.

label: Security & Guard Services
description: Coordinate guard deployments, installations and customer-service follow-up.

workflows.label: Guard deployments
workflows.description: Reserve a guard or crew for a site shift. Do not enter access codes, alarm secrets or sensitive incident details.

workflows.label: Installation jobs
workflows.description: Track alarm/CCTV installation scope and completion tasks.

workflows.label: Service checks
workflows.description: Track routine customer-service tasks; urgent incidents require your established response channels.

label: Beauty Salons, Spas & Barbershops
description: Organize client appointments, packages and service follow-ups.

workflows.label: Appointments
workflows.description: Reserve a stylist, barber or treatment resource.

workflows.label: Client packages
workflows.description: Track agreed service packages and manually received payments.

workflows.label: Client follow-ups
workflows.description: Track non-clinical client service and appointment follow-up.

label: Commercial Laundromats & Dry Cleaners
description: Track intake, cleaning work and collection/delivery.

workflows.label: Laundry orders
workflows.description: Record intake quantities, cleaning instructions and collection dates.

workflows.label: Quality checks
workflows.description: Track inspection and rework against an intake reference.

workflows.label: Collections & deliveries
workflows.description: Coordinate customer pickup and laundry delivery.

label: Boutiques & Apparel Stores
description: Keep stock, customer orders and alteration work together.

workflows.label: Customer orders
workflows.description: Track requested styles, sizes and collection dates; checkout records stock sales separately.

workflows.label: Alterations
workflows.description: Track tailoring instructions and completion targets.

workflows.label: Supplier arrivals
workflows.description: Track expected stock deliveries before goods receipt.

label: Printing & Branding Firms
description: Track production specifications, proof approval and installation.

workflows.label: Print jobs
workflows.description: Track print specifications, quantities and production deadlines.

workflows.label: Proof approvals
workflows.description: Record artwork proof references and approval follow-up; files and final client approval are handled separately.

workflows.label: Delivery & installation
workflows.description: Coordinate signage delivery or on-site installation.
